long_biography.plain_text:
Phelan Green Group made Paschal Phelan a prominent developer in South African renewable energy. When the country shaped its independent-power programme, he pressed for solar to be included and Solar Capital subsequently secured contracts for projects near De Aar. The resulting complex established his group as a utility-scale photovoltaic operator.

Phelan paired project development with a commitment to local economic programmes, arguing that training and community investment should outlast construction. As chairman, he now directs a platform extending beyond solar into battery storage, wind power and low-carbon fuels. Its model combines land assembly, project finance and technical teams to develop energy assets in South Africa and other markets.
